cases.name: Katie Smith Mobley
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Katie’s life centered around her children, Gentrie and Gannon, and she gave selflessly in her role as a mother. Katie provided for her young family by working at Georgia Power, a job she genuinely enjoyed. When possible, she would hang out at the lake, or unwind on trips to her favorite place, Bell Mountain. Katie believed in practicing self-care and carved out time in her busy life to run and workout."
